title: Operation contract extends compiled module declarations
decision:
- `operation-contract/1` is an additive normal form over existing module
  declarations, not `Operation::definition()` on handler classes.
- Existing `Api::operation()` signature remains; mode, scopes, idempotency,
  fields, pagination, capability and deprecation use fluent serializable metadata.
- `OperationRegistry`, `ApiProfile`, OpenAPI and tools are projections of the same
  compiled snapshot and upstream fingerprint.
- Bulk modes are declared in P13 but fail `operation_unsupported` until P14 owns
  lifecycle/store semantics.
rationale:
Moving authority into handler statics would duplicate discovery, break compile-time
validation and make tools/OpenAPI disagree with module manifests. Fluent additions
preserve callers while making the new semantics compiler-visible.

sections.title: D65 — Operation contract extends compiled module declarations
sections.text:
**Actor:** plan-designer/codex-gpt-5.6-sol/high
**Evidence:** RAG:— the current authority is `Extend\Api` compiled into one module
snapshot; D56 forbids a parallel mutable registry. Existing operation calls are
positional and must remain readable.

sections.title: Решение
sections.text:
- `operation-contract/1` is an additive normal form over existing module
  declarations, not `Operation::definition()` on handler classes.
- Existing `Api::operation()` signature remains; mode, scopes, idempotency,
  fields, pagination, capability and deprecation use fluent serializable metadata.
- `OperationRegistry`, `ApiProfile`, OpenAPI and tools are projections of the same
  compiled snapshot and upstream fingerprint.
- Bulk modes are declared in P13 but fail `operation_unsupported` until P14 owns
  lifecycle/store semantics.

sections.title: Почему
sections.text:
Moving authority into handler statics would duplicate discovery, break compile-time
validation and make tools/OpenAPI disagree with module manifests. Fluent additions
preserve callers while making the new semantics compiler-visible.

sections.title: Consequences
sections.text:
P13.1 extends declaration validation and runtime projection. P13.3 builds an
immutable profile without a second registration lifecycle. P13.12 freezes the
result under G-API.
